name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.MultiPass.change_rank_le
title: The change matrix of a walk at a fixed cut has rank at most the row width
statement: Rows X x (prefix rows at a fixed cut, over a field) and linear residual maps L t. For any family of columns col j = (t_j, u_j), the matrix whose (x, j) entry is L (t_j + 1) (X x) u_j - L t_j (X x) u_j has rank at most card iota.
